ETag.description: Entity tag for conditional requests (If-Match / If-None-Match)

Idempotency-Replayed.description: `true` when this response is a replay of a stored idempotent response

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the current window

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window

X-Request-Id.description: Request id (req_ ULID); echoed from the request when valid

Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from next_cursor; expires after 24 h, bound to the same filters

IdempotencyKeyOptional.description: ULID or UUID, max 64 chars; stored 24 h. Needed for safe retries of this POST.
IdempotencyKeyOptional.name: Idempotency-Key

IfMatch.description: ETag of the resource version being modified; mismatch gives 412 precondition_failed
IfMatch.name: If-Match

RequestIdHeader.description: Optional client request id (valid req_ ULID); the server reuses it
RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-Id

BadRequest.description: 400: invalid_request, idempotency_key_required, unsupported_protocol, invalid_grant, authorization_pending, slow_down, expired_token, invalid_scope, invalid_frame, protocol_violation, signature_invalid

Conflict.description: 409: conflict, idempotency_conflict, member_exists, session_paused, queue_item_gone, lock_denied, key_required, key_unknown, snapshot_hash_mismatch, account_deletion_pending, export_not_ready

Forbidden.description: 403: access_denied, forbidden, not_a_member, role_insufficient, entitlement_required, seat_limit_reached, member_limit_reached, subscription_inactive, owner_required, session_full, session_locked, host_required, muted, queue_not_allowed, webhook_limit_reached, api_key_limit_reached, pair_bad_code

NotFound.description: 404: not_found, workspace_not_found, invite_invalid, session_not_found, device_unknown, snapshot_missing

RateLimited.description: 429: rate_limited, quota_exceeded, slow_consumer, frame_rate_exceeded, queue_full, pair_locked_out

Unauthorized.description: 401: unauthorized, token_expired, token_invalid, token_revoked, device_revoked, refresh_reuse_detected, invalid_client, ticket_invalid, ticket_replayed

apiKeyAuth.description: Machine credential with an explicit scope subset. Cannot mint relay tickets or join sessions. Accepted only on operations that list it in `security`.

bearerAuth.description: EdDSA access token (15 min, aud centcom-api). OAuth scopes are listed per operation in x-scopes (profile, workspaces:read, ...).

info.description: Machine-readable REST contract for Centcom (contract_version 1.0.0). Wins over contracts/02-rest-api.md on disagreement. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json with stable codes from errors.json. Clients must ignore unknown response fields and tolerate unknown enum values (CT-VER).
info.title: Centcom REST API

get.description: Public JWKS of EdDSA token-signing keys; no authentication.
Liveness probe; never touches dependencies and needs no authentication.
Readiness probe; 200 only when DB, Redis and migrations are OK, otherwise 503 with failing checks; no authentication.
Lists API keys (prefix only); admins see all workspace keys, members only their own.

post.description: Creates an API key whose secret is returned once; admins and owners may create any key, members only for themselves, subject to api_keys_max.

delete.description: Revokes an API key; admins may revoke any key, members only their own.

get.description: Public browser endpoint that starts an authorization-code + PKCE (S256 only) flow and redirects to the login page or redirect_uri.

parameters.description: Exact match against the registered allow-list (e.g. centcom://auth/callback)
parameters.name: redirect_uri

302.description: Redirect to the login page, or to redirect_uri with `code` and `state`

post.description: Starts an RFC 8628 device flow and registers the device public keys; no authentication required (public clients, 20 req/min/IP).

get.description: Lists the caller's registered devices; any authenticated user, own devices only.

delete.description: Revokes one of the caller's devices, kills its tokens and flags its keys; any authenticated user, own devices only.

post.description: Revokes a refresh token or one of the caller's devices per RFC 7009 (always 200 for unknown tokens); any authenticated user for own credentials.
post.summary: Revoke a refresh token or device

post.description: Exchanges a device code, PKCE authorization code or refresh token for tokens; public endpoint, web clients must send X-Centcom-Client: web.

parameters.description: Must be `web` for browser clients (CSRF guard)
parameters.name: X-Centcom-Client

get.description: Lists the caller's own devices; any authenticated user.

delete.description: Revokes one of the caller's devices and kills its tokens; any authenticated user, own devices only.

get.description: Returns one of the caller's devices (name, platform, last seen, key fingerprint); any authenticated user, own devices only.
Returns the public X25519 and Ed25519 keys of a device (CT-CRYPTO); only users who share a session with the device owner.
get.x-role: any member who shares a session

get.description: Returns flags evaluated for the caller (anonymous allowed), cached by ETag; no scope required, profile scope used when authenticated.

delete.description: Revokes a pending invite; admins and owners of the invite's workspace.

put.description: Uploads a sealed key bundle (CT-CRYPTO section 4) for an invite; session host only. Server stores ciphertext only.

get.description: Public preview of an invite (workspace name, inviter, role, expiry); anyone holding the token.

post.description: Accepts the invite and creates the membership; any authenticated user holding a valid token (seat entitlement is checked).

get.description: Fetches the sealed key bundle once and then deletes it; the invitee only.

delete.description: Starts account deletion with a 30-day grace period (Location points at the status resource); any authenticated user, own account only.

Location.description: URL of the created or status resource

get.description: Returns the current user, plan summary, active workspace and entitlement revision; any authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates display name, locale, avatar slot and telemetry opt-in; any authenticated user, own profile only.

post.description: Requests an asynchronous export of the caller's data; any authenticated user, own data only.

Location.description: URL of the created or status resource

get.description: Returns export status and, when ready, a signed download URL; any authenticated user, own exports only.

post.description: Cancels a scheduled deletion during the 30-day grace period. Any authenticated user may restore their own account.

get.description: Returns channels per category and quiet hours; any authenticated user.

put.description: Replaces the caller's notification preferences; any authenticated user.

get.description: Lists the caller's notifications, newest first; any authenticated user.

post.description: Marks all of the caller's notifications read; any authenticated user.
Marks one of the caller's notifications read; any authenticated user.

get.description: Public list of plans and prices (USD/EUR); no authentication.

delete.description: Deletes a project; admins and owners of the owning workspace.

patch.description: Updates a project; members and above of the owning workspace.

post.description: Registers a web-push, APNs or FCM token; any authenticated user.

delete.description: Unregisters one of the caller's push subscriptions; any authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the latest manifest for a platform and arch on a channel; public.
Returns the full manifest (all platforms) for a channel; public.
Lists sessions visible to the caller; members and above.

parameters.description: Only sessions the caller hosts or belongs to
parameters.name: mine

post.description: Creates a command post after checking the relay entitlement and concurrent-session limit; members and above (not billing or guests).

Location.description: URL of the created or status resource

get.description: Returns session detail, state, policy and region; session participants.

patch.description: Renames the session and/or changes policy defaults; host only.

post.description: Claims the host role when the host is gone; workspace admins and owners only.
Ends the session and closes all connections; host only.

delete.description: Purges durable history and snapshots and writes an audit event; host or workspace owner.

get.description: Returns ciphertext frames after after_seq (CT-RESUME), paginated; session participants.

parameters.description: Return frames with seq greater than this
parameters.name: after_seq

post.description: Mints a single-use 60 s relay ticket (CT-AUTH); session participants only, never API keys.

get.description: Lists members with slot, role, device keys and join order; session participants.

post.description: Creates a viewer-only guest link valid up to 24 h; host only.

delete.description: Revokes a guest share link; host only.

get.description: Returns the latest snapshot descriptor with a pre-signed GET URL; session participants.

post.description: Begins a snapshot upload and returns a pre-signed PUT (<= 32 MiB); host only.
Commits an uploaded snapshot with {seq, sha256, size, kid}; the server verifies size and hash only; host only.
Public, rate-limited join as a limited viewer guest using a share-link token; returns a relay ticket.

get.description: Public status feed cached 15 s at the edge; no authentication.

post.description: Accepts an opt-in telemetry batch of up to 100 events and always returns 204, even when dropped; anonymous or authenticated.
Ingests up to 500 usage events (body up to 1 MiB) deduped by id; devices of authenticated users only, 60 req/min/device.

delete.description: Deletes a webhook endpoint; admins and owners.

get.description: Returns one webhook endpoint; admins and owners of its workspace.

patch.description: Updates url, events or enabled flag, or rotates the secret with rotate_secret:true; admins and owners.

get.description: Lists deliveries for the endpoint; admins and owners.

post.description: Schedules a redelivery of a past delivery; admins and owners.
Sends a test event to the endpoint; admins and owners.

get.description: Lists workspaces the caller belongs to; any authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a workspace and makes the caller its owner; any authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes the workspace with immediate history purge and 7-day billing wind-down; owner only.

get.description: Returns workspace detail with an ETag; members and above.

patch.description: Renames the workspace and/or updates settings (If-Match); admins and owners.

get.description: Lists audit events with filters actor, action, from and to; admins and owners, requires audit_log_days > 0.

post.description: Starts a CSV or JSON audit export; admins and owners.

Location.description: URL of the created or status resource

get.description: Returns export status and download URL; admins and owners.

post.description: Creates a hosted checkout session and returns its URL; owner and billing roles.
Redeems a coupon code for the workspace; owner and billing roles.

get.description: Returns the workspace entitlements (CT-ENTITLEMENTS) with rev; members and above.
Lists pending invites; admins and owners.

post.description: Creates an email or link invite after checking the seat entitlement; admins and owners.

get.description: Lists invoices, paginated; owner and billing roles.
Lists members with roles (presence-agnostic); members and above.

delete.description: Removes a member, or lets a member remove themselves; admins and owners, or the member themselves (the owner cannot leave without transferring).

patch.description: Changes a member's workspace role; admins and owners, and owners cannot be changed here.

post.description: Creates a billing-portal session and returns its URL; owner and billing roles.

get.description: Lists projects (named repo references); members and above.

post.description: Creates a project in the workspace; members and above.

patch.description: Changes the seat count, or with ?preview=true returns a proration preview without changing; owner and billing roles.

get.description: Returns policies (default auto-approve level, history sharing, retention override); members and above.

patch.description: Updates workspace policies (If-Match); admins and owners.

get.description: Returns subscription state; owner, billing and admin roles.

post.description: Hands workspace ownership to an admin; owner only.

get.description: Returns period usage versus limits; members and above.
Lists webhook endpoints; admins and owners.

post.description: Creates a webhook endpoint and returns its signing secret once; admins and owners, subject to webhooks_max.
